screeningInstructions:
Before beginning the main study, please complete this short listening task.

For each item, listen to the Reference, Version A, and Version B. One of the two versions is identical to the Reference.

Which of A or B matches the Reference?

You may replay the audio as many times as needed before submitting your answer.
